reply.text: {"say":"Shoulders this session, finished with a giant set of three raises covering front and rear delts.","title":"Shoulders","days":[{"name":"Shoulders","exercises":[{"key":"seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep ribs down, press straight overhead."},{"key":"machine-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with the elbows, pause briefly at the top."},{"key":"dumbbell-front-raise","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Raise to shoulder height, control the lowering."},{"key":"dumbbell-rear-delt-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Hinge forward, squeeze the shoulder blades together."},{"key":"band-front-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"Keep tension constant through the full range."},{"key":"band-pull-apart","sets":3,"reps":15,"repsTo":20,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"Arms straight, pull the band to chest level."}]}],"unmet":[]}
